course_name_original: University of Parma - English Test - B1 Cefr.
course_name_en: University of Parma - English Test - B1 Cefr.
prerequisites: Elementary knowledge of English (at least at the A2 level).

learning_outcomes.text: To develop or consolidate students' English skills related to grammar, vocabulary, language functions, reading and listening comprehension corresponding to the B1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
Understand the main points of clear standard written and spoken input in the foreign language on familiar matters regularly encountered in work, school, leisure, etc.
Deal with most situations likely to arise while travelling in an area where the language is spoken.

syllabus_topics: General English skills to the B1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), including grammar and vocabulary topics.
teaching_methods: Courses held by native language teachers
Online self-study course 'PREPARAZIONE IDONEITÀ INGLESE B1'
Practice exercises on exam topics with automatic correction
assessment_rules: The 'idoneità' is a pass/fail exam which assesses grammar, vocabulary, reading, and listening skills at the B1 level. It is a computer-based multiple-choice test. To pass, at least 60% of the questions must be answered correctly.
bibliography: R. Murphy, L. Pallini, Essential Grammar in Use (Cambridge University Press)
S. Redman, English Vocabulary in Use: Pre-intermediate and Intermediate (Cambridge University Press)
